sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 47 (#46 tests_and_key_are_out_of_agent_reach) and Internal Quality Checks row 47 (same text, no extra annotation)
evidence: Agent image is template-identical (cmp) task/environment/Dockerfile: built from environment/ context and copies only instructions/ (6 brief notes) and assets/ (seed_data.json with empty snippets) at lines 14-15; no tests/, criteria, judge CLI, codex or harbor-rewardkit is installed (only express/better-sqlite3, lines 9-11). grep for judge|rubric|criteri|score|reward|verifier|/tests over instruction.md, instructions/*.md, solve.sh and server/src finds nothing. Grading is isolated: task.toml:28 environment_mode = "separate"; criteria, claude-code/codex and rewardkit==0.1.7 live only in template-identical tests/Dockerfile (lines 16-31, COPY . /tests with chmod -R go-rwx /tests at line 44). In the verifier, test.sh (template-identical) writes a zero reward first (line 60), rejects symlinks escaping /app (72-83), runs the submission as uid 65534 under env -i (104-111) so it cannot read root-only /tests or the OPENROUTER token, keeps LOG_DIR chmod 700 under umask 077 (3,11) so the app cannot write reward.txt/reward.json, and computes reward via /tests/tools/score.py. Broken-app attempt: an /app that writes /logs/verifier/reward.txt or reads /tests/scored/*/prompt.md is blocked by uid 65534 vs root 700/go-rwx perms; a conforming app is never penalised by this isolation. Residual vectors (judge prompt injection via app UI) belong to row 45; a submission reading judge argv via world-readable /proc/*/cmdline at grading time is unmeasured and latent only (shared harness, not task-editable), and would not let the agent read criteria during authoring. Not exercised on v16 bytes by a hosted run; v15 hosted runs (oracle 1.0, nop 0) used the same template-identical images.
